provider_reported_usage.interpretation: Provider-reported token usage only. Requests without provider usage are excluded, not silently mixed with estimates.

summary.cost_basis: Token counts use provider metadata when available and remain separate from chars/4 estimates. Dollar values use explicit pricing assumptions for engineering capacity planning, not audited billing.

route_cost_comparison.description: Hosted/API answer path with retrieval, generation, source governance, and validators.
route_cost_comparison.basis: engineering estimate from current token/latency telemetry; not provider billing truth

route_cost_comparison.description: Validated low-risk cached answer tied to the current KB fingerprint.

route_cost_comparison.description: Local SLM rewrites/query-plans; API path still answers behind validators.
route_cost_comparison.basis: engineering estimate from current token/latency telemetry; not provider billing truth

route_cost_comparison.description: No retrieval/generation for blocked diagnosis, treatment, prognosis, dosage, genetic-risk, or tumor-marker claims.
route_cost_comparison.basis: engineering estimate from current token/latency telemetry; not provider billing truth

local_probe_stage_latency.interpretation: Stage timings come from the repeated local route probe and remain separate from legacy database rows with no stage envelope.

instrumentation.legacy_gap: Rows created before schema revision 0011 may not have token_usage_json, and rows before revision 0005 may not have stage_latency_json. Missing fields remain null or explicitly estimated instead of being presented as provider-reported usage.
instrumentation.privacy: No prompts or completions are retained in token_usage_json.

recommendations: Keep deterministic-only refusal for blocked medical decision requests because it has the lowest cost and avoids unsafe generation.
Use local SLM only for low-risk routing/rewrite/extraction helpers; final medical education remains behind source governance and validators.
Provider token coverage is below 80%; keep provider-reported totals separate from chars/4 estimates until new instrumented traffic increases coverage.
Cached path estimated p50 is 202.87ms when cache policy allows reuse.
claim_boundary: Cost and latency observability is engineering telemetry only. It does not establish clinical safety, clinical validation, or real-world patient benefit.
